headline: Omics variation resolved into reproducible modules, fluxes, states and network-level mechanisms
label: Interpretable Omics Variation Modules
summary: New CHO iModulons, pan-cancer flux models and single-cell state maps recast omics variation as interpretable units beyond individual genes.
synthesis: The dominant thread is replacing gene-level readouts with interpretable units of variation. Robust multi-run ICA on 778 CHO RNA-seq samples yields 105 reproducible iModulons that project onto new datasets, and a companion CHO tissue-versus-cell-line transcriptome study addresses immortalization signatures and lineage divergence. Metabolic work shifts the unit to flux: Recon3D modeling across 33 TCGA types nominates CRLS1, and M-SCAN infers sample-specific genome-scale fluxes from RNA, mutations and kcat. At single-cell resolution, a UCE-based framework maps 22,161 bridges among 614 states. TRAFIKK adds mechanistic signalling-network simulation for drug synergy, and a spatial transcriptomic framework improves anticancer compound prediction. The units differ across studies (modules, fluxes, state transitions, network perturbations) and no shared framework emerges.
